name: Mo Li Long Zhu
categoryNote: 花茶 is a treatment applied to a base tea. Jasmine pearls are a green tea that was scented — scented is not one of the six classes.
cultivar: green-tea base, often Funing or similar

harvest.window: spring green base; summer jasmine blossoms

pluckStandard: tips rolled into pearls, scented over nights

processing.description: Young leaf processed as green tea, then rolled into pearls.
Layered with fresh jasmine over several nights; flowers are removed. Grade is number of scentings.

profile.mouthfeel: light, perfumed, should still taste like tea
profile.finish: jasmine that does not turn soapy if well scented

water.note: Soft, 75–80 °C. Boiling cooks the blossom into perfume-cleaner.

storage: Triple-sealed; jasmine evaporates and also contaminates other teas.

qualityMarkers.claim: multiple scentings, no leftover flowers in the tin

summary: Green pearls scented overnight with real jasmine: garden perfume that should still drink as tea.
